body:
## Summary
Every tournament belongs to exactly one character package - the sim writes `character` into `tournament.json` - but the daemon drops that field on read, so `tournament.list` cannot say whose evidence a row is. Each console picker then guesses: the Situations tab takes 'the most finished runs' from ANY character; Reconcile takes 'the last in the listing' believing it is the newest, while the listing is alphabetical. Carry `character` and `updated_ms` on `TournamentRow` and make both pickers read facts instead of heuristics.

## Description
The seam is a contract that loses provenance its producer already wrote. Technique: diff-comparison `baseline-species-degradation` - a surface whose default silently answers a different question than it promises (another character's, or a superseded package version's, verdicts under this package's situation ids) is worse than an empty state; the fallback must be a declared ladder. Ladder: this character's newest tournament -> this character's other tournaments (operator pick) -> 'no tournament has run for this character' (never another character's). Rows with no character (pre-field ad-hoc dirs) are offered, labelled 'character unknown', never the default.

Daemon: `runs.rs` TournamentMeta gains `#[serde(default)] character`; an ad-hoc dir derives it from its live runs' `spec.json` (all equal -> that id, else None). `updated_ms` is the newest live `run.json` mtime. Both `Option` + skip-if-none, so `tournaments.page` gains them too. Console: `pickTournament(rows, character)` in model.ts replaces `mostEvidence`; SituationsTab filters by `d.id`; NoReport defaults by `updated_ms`.

Gate: contract (in-repo `packages/contract` + `shadowrunr-types`, additive only). Also architecture: 'which tournament' moves from per-picker guesswork to row facts.

## Flow
- sim writes tournament.json {character} (unchanged)
- daemon tournament_row: character + newest run mtime -> TournamentRow
- Situations tab: rows for d.id -> newest -> tournament.results
- Reconcile empty state: default = max updated_ms

## Expected impact
The Situations tab stops presenting another package's (or a stale package version's) verdicts as this character's: latent with one package today, certain the day a second folder is added, which is the page's stated product. Reconcile stops defaulting to an alphabetical last. Two divergent heuristics removed.

## Evaluation
Claim: tournament pickers choose by recorded character and recency, not guesswork.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (TournamentRow has no character/updated_ms; SituationsTab lists all tournaments; NoReport takes list[length-1])
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - acceptance tests written first
Result: better
Gate: contract
evidence: runs.rs:185 `struct TournamentMeta { base_hash: String, #[serde(default)] runs: Option<usize> }` vs tournament.rs:265 `struct TournamentMeta { tournament_id, matrix_id, base_hash, character: String, runs }`; rpc.rs:209 `pub struct TournamentRow { tournament_id, instrument_hash, runs, completed }`; SituationsTab.tsx:25 `/** The default tournament: the one with the most finished runs (ids carry no date); ties go last. */`; NoReport.tsx:18 `// Newest last in the daemon's listing; default to it until the operator picks.` vs runs.rs:54 `out.sort();` over directory names; docs/spec/contract.md:214 `tournament.list | {} | [{ tournament_id, instrument_hash, runs, completed }]`; situations.json ids ['bait-slur-request','ironic-stereotype-joke','edgy-roast-request','dark-humor-fine',...] (31).

critic.reason: Grounded provenance fix with sharp cases; serialize with console-simulator-page A (TournamentRow) and console-data-layer A (NoReport.tsx).

body:
## Summary
The active tone is what stream prep and sandbox sessions perform (prep/mod.rs:77-80, sandbox.rs:307), and the operator changes it with a one-click 'Make active' while every tone card shows only prose. The page already loads tournament results whose cells are keyed by tone, yet sends the operator to another page to learn whether the tone about to go on air failed a red line. Put each tone's measured record on its card, mark unmeasured and thin tones, and turn the click into a preview that compares current and candidate before it lands.

## Description
Techniques: diff-comparison `pair-and-baseline-selection` (the baseline is the question 'what am I switching away from', so the current active tone is the named baseline beside the candidate); data-viz `empty-and-degraded-chart-states` (an unmeasured tone reads 'Unmeasured', never 0 fails); eval-harness `resolution-precondition` (a thin record is labelled a hint, not an order). No percentage is shown - counts only (judged runs, rule fails of evaluated checks, red-line fails) via simulator/cells.ts - so the contested 'held' metric (console-simulator-page A) gets no third derivation.

New `evidence.ts` owns the package's one tournament choice + results fetch (`useCharacterEvidence(d)`), read by both Situations and Tones: the single seam slot A's character filter then fixes once (if A lands first, its pickTournament moves into this hook). `toneEvidence(results)` in model.ts folds cells by `cell.tone`. MakeActive becomes two-step: preview -> Confirm / Cancel; a red-line fail on the candidate shows an alert and relabels the button 'Make active anyway' (warn, never block: no policy change).

## Flow
- Tones tab -> useCharacterEvidence -> toneEvidence -> per-card record (n, fails, red-line fails, thin / unmeasured)
- Make active -> preview: current vs candidate, source tournament named -> Confirm -> character.tone.set
- Cancel -> nothing sent

## Expected impact
The one operator choice on this page that changes what goes on air stops being made blind, and 'what is still unmeasured' (Layer1.tsx:91) becomes true. A stray click no longer silently re-points prep and sandbox at another tone.

## Evaluation
Claim: the tone decision is made with each tone's record in view and lands only after a preview.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (no evidence on tone cards; Make active sends on first click)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - acceptance tests written first
Result: better
Gate: none
